notes.title: Would you like to see translation to your language?
notes.content:
Hi there!
From time to time I notice requests for translations. Usually, I had to decline because I did not see enough demand for it. Additionally, adding a translation is just a tiny step, I have no clue where are foreign Adult-Only communities to inform them about the fact that the game is available in their language.

I've noticed Polish being asked a few times across my games and Poland is surprisingly high in my reports, but I don't know if adding language matters. Translations are a bit complex technically and I will have to hire someone to do the translation. But it's not impossible. Maybe there are other languages you would like to see, but nobody is asking?

Don't worry, I will not be using AI or Google Translate. I would hire a translator to ensure high quality.

[b]Please go to "Discuss" below and type the language you would be interested in, I will count the responses and we will see.[/b]
